notes.title: 1.08 patch
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the Skull Head boss could get stuck and become unable to move.

notes.title: 1.07 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added functionality to change keyboard and mouse key bindings in settings.
[*] The mouse is now confined within the game window to prevent accidental clicks for muti-screen players.
[*] Removed the halving effect on titanium income in simple mode.
[*] Titanium income when falling changed from halved to -20%.
[*] Added a confirmation UI for retreating and restarting.
[*] Updated the sound effect for picking up crystals.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.06 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the achievement for unlocking all levels.
[*] Removed saving Debug files at the end of each level.
[*] Challenge mode unlocks after clearing a level once.
[*] Fixed a bug with sea surface reflections.
[/list]
